about.title: About Sunday Properties
about.subtitle: We help international buyers and renters navigate sale and rental in Colombia — with verified visits, title documents, and clear negotiation before you commit.

mission.title: What we do
mission.description: Sunday Properties is a brokerage platform for sale and rental in Medellín. We coordinate visits, document review, and offer negotiation — without inflated marketing claims.

features.verified: Listings with real photos and documented specs
features.visits: Scheduled visits before offers or contracts
features.legal: Title and contract support through our legal network when needed
features.transparent: Offer history and fees visible in the platform

model.title: Intermediation, not inventory
model.description: We represent owners and buyers or tenants. We do not present Sunday as a property developer or as a law firm — clarity on role is part of the brand.

values.title: Principles
values.subtitle: What guides how we list, show, and close properties

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Prices, area, and listing status match what we can verify — no brochure inflation.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.description: Plain language for international clients on visits, deposits, and closing steps.

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: Relationships built on documented facts, not anonymous team bios.
